title: 第三章 破限渔获丰收第四章 捕鱼藏宝
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
“终于……圆满了！”
苏羽压抑着心中的激动。
此刻，他对撒网的感觉已圆满于心，目光扫过水面，何处有鱼，何处水流湍急，皆了然于胸。
出手、撒网、收网，行云流水，一气呵成。
但这，仅仅是技艺本身的圆满。
“破限！”
他心念一动，那1点破限点，瞬间融入了撒网技艺之中。
眼前墨色的文字一阵闪烁，焕然一新。
【技艺】：撒网（破限1次）
【特性】：撒网亦是道。三次之内，必中渔获。
“好一个撒网亦是道！”苏羽心潮澎湃。
三次必中渔获，意味着只要他出手三次，就绝不会空手而归！
这黑水河广袤无垠，其中潜藏的珍稀宝鱼何其之多？以往是可遇不可求，如今，只要被自己碰上，它们就能被自己扣入网中！
“哈哈哈哈！”苏羽望着烟波浩渺的黑水河面，只觉胸中豪气顿生，心情畅快大笑。
区区撒网技艺尚能如此，若是武道功法破限，又该是何等光景？
这一刻，他仿佛看到了一条通天大道，在自己脚下缓缓展开。
而且这破限似乎没说只能破限1次，不知道是否还能继续破下去。
可惜如今没有破限点了，按照之前的经验，还是要摄入各种能量，才能慢慢积攒。
【破限点】0点（进度1%）
“不急，一步一个脚印！”

苏羽按捺住心绪，再次抛出渔网。这一次，他感觉手中的网仿佛活了过来，如臂使指，精准地落入他感知到的一个鱼群之中。
不到一个时辰，他身后的鱼篓便已沉甸甸，几乎满了。
“够了！”
苏羽看着满篓的肥鱼，青鱼，鲤鱼，鲫鱼……
自己没有舢板船，仅在岸边便有如此收获，太过扎眼，若是天天如此，必会引来祸端。
不过偶尔的一次也说的过去，就说碰到鱼窝了。
苏羽收拾好渔获，没有立即回去。而是寻了个隐蔽的河湾，耐心等到日暮西沉，才背着沉重的鱼篓，朝清溪镇集市走去。
清溪镇集市，这里是附近唯一的市场，里面鱼市，猎市，粮铺，杂货店等五脏俱全。
集市入口，水蛇帮的两名帮众斜倚着门柱，目光懒散地扫过每一个进出的人。
“哟，小子不错啊，竟然捕了这么多鱼。”其中一人拦下苏羽，用下巴指了指他满溢的鱼篓。
“运气好，碰上个鱼窝。”苏羽熟练地应付道。
“10文！”
苏羽立马递上十枚铜钱。
那人掂了掂铜钱，这才挥了挥手：“进去吧。”
进入集市，苏羽直奔鱼市附近，找到三叔家的鱼摊，三婶和三叔一个在收鱼，一个在杀鱼，配合熟练。
鱼摊是爷爷留下来的，早年苏家的孩子都是靠这鱼摊养活的，如今是三叔一家在经营。
“小羽？快来快来！”三婶陈氏眼尖，一改往日的刻薄，满脸堆笑地迎了上来，热情地帮他卸下鱼篓，“城里的百鱼鲜酒楼今儿要得多，鱼价都涨了一文钱呢！”
“哎哟！”鱼篓落在案板上，发出一声闷响，陈氏惊呼道：“这么沉！我的好大侄，你这是把龙王爷的鱼塘给抄了？”
content_en:
"Finally...complete!"
Su Yu suppressed the excitement in his heart.
At this moment, he had perfected the feeling of casting the net in his heart. His eyes swept across the water, and he knew where the fish were and where the current was fast.
Take action, cast the net, and close the net, all in one go.
But this is only the perfection of the skill itself.
"Break the limit!"
With a thought in his mind, that 1 point of breaking the limit was instantly integrated into the skill of casting the net.
The ink-colored text in front of me flickered and took on a new look.
[Skill]: Casting the net (limit 1 time)
[Characteristics]: Casting a net is also the way. Within three times, you will surely catch the fish.
"It's a good idea to cast a net!" Su Yu's heart was surging.
Three times he is sure to catch the fish, which means that as long as he takes three shots, he will never come back empty-handed!
This Blackwater River is vast and vast, how many rare treasure fish are hidden in it? In the past, they could only be encountered but not sought, but now, as long as they are encountered by themselves, they can be caught in the net by themselves!
"Hahahaha!" Su Yu looked at the vast black water of the river, feeling proud in his chest and laughing happily.
His net-casting skills are still like this, but what will happen if his martial arts skills break the limit?
At this moment, he seemed to see a road to the sky slowly unfolding under his feet.
And it doesn’t seem to say that this limit can only be broken once. I don’t know if it can continue to be broken.
It's a pity that there is no limit-breaking point now. According to previous experience, you still need to take in various kinds of energy in order to slowly accumulate it.
[Break limit point] 0 points (progress 1%)
"Don't rush, just take it one step at a time!"
Su Yu suppressed his emotions and threw the fishing net again. This time, he felt as if the net in his hand came alive, like an arm, and accurately fell into a school of fish that he sensed.
In less than an hour, the fish basket behind him was heavy and almost full.
"Enough!"
Su Yu looked at the basket full of fat fish, herring, carp, crucian carp...
I don't have a sampan, so to have such a harvest just on the shore is too eye-catching. If it happens every day, it will definitely lead to disaster.
But once in a while, it's okay to say that I encountered a fish nest.
Su Yu packed up his catch and did not go back immediately. Instead, he found a hidden river bend and waited patiently until sunset before carrying a heavy fish basket and walking towards the market in Qingxi Town.
Qingxi Town Market is the only market nearby. It has a fish market, hunting market, grain shop, grocery store, etc.
At the entrance of the market, two members of the Water Snake Gang were leaning against the doorpost, their eyes lazily scanning everyone who came in and out.
"Hey, you're good, you caught so many fish." One of them stopped Su Yu and pointed to his overflowing fish basket with his chin.
"You're lucky, you came across a fish nest." Su Yu dealt with it skillfully.
"10 Wen!"
Su Yu immediately handed over ten copper coins.
The man weighed the copper coins and then waved his hand: "Go in."
Entering the market, Su Yu went straight to the fish market and found the fish stall of his third uncle's house. One of the third aunt and the third uncle was collecting fish and the other was killing them. They worked together skillfully.
The fish stall was left by my grandfather. In the early years, the children of the Su family relied on this fish stall to support themselves. Now it is run by the third uncle's family.
"Xiao Yu? Come on, come on!" Third Aunt Chen, with sharp eyes, changed from her usual meanness, came up to him with a smile on her face, and enthusiastically helped him unload the fish basket, "The fish restaurants in the city are much more popular today, and the price of fish has increased by a penny!"
"Ouch!" The fish basket fell on the chopping board with a muffled sound, and Mrs. Chen exclaimed: "It's so heavy! My great nephew, have you stolen the Dragon Prince's fish pond?"
